title: Footsteps Outside the Gate  (Pasos al otro lado del portón)

segments.t: ¡Faltan dos minutos para las tres en el Patio de los Tilos! Los farolillos de la azotea se mecen suavemente sobre veintiocho cubiertos de lino sujetos con pinzas, cuatro pasteles de bayas de verano relucen sobre bandejas blancas, y Hannah, Tessa y Arthur se reúnen junto al portón abierto del patio. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Quick check before three strikes: jacket buttoned, shoes polished — where are my glasses?!
Miracle of miracles, Arthur, they are sitting squarely on your nose!
Do not touch them! Table one has hot mint tea, black tea, and warm plates ready.
Evelyn is at the walnut piano, and both Room Two and Six guests are smiling!
We actually pulled off a six-hour celebration in a hundred and eighty minutes!
Listen — do you hear the municipal clock tower chiming three up Linden Street?
One chime, two chimes, three chimes... and wait, a car door just closed outside!
Someone just rang the brass gate bell twice — that is the signal from the brothers!
Look through the archway: Owen is carrying a battered brown leather suitcase!
And walking beside Caleb with a silver walking stick and a wide straw hat...
Remember to lift the iron gate handle slightly first, Arthur, and smile!
Welcome back to Linden Courtyard, my friend — thirty summers to the very week!
Analicemos ahora frase por frase los últimos minutos antes de la llegada.
Quick check before three strikes: jacket buttoned, shoes polished — where are my glasses?!
'Última revisión antes de que den las tres: chaqueta abotonada, zapatos lustrados... ¿¡dónde están mis gafas!?'
Miracle of miracles, Arthur, they are sitting squarely on your nose!
'¡Milagro de milagros, Arthur, están perfectamente puestas sobre tu nariz!'
Do not touch them! Table one has hot mint tea, black tea, and warm plates ready.
'¡No las toques! La mesa uno tiene té de menta caliente, té negro y platos calientes listos.'
Evelyn is at the walnut piano, and both Room Two and Six guests are smiling!
'Evelyn está al piano de nogal, ¡y los huéspedes de las habitaciones Dos y Seis están sonriendo!'
We actually pulled off a six-hour celebration in a hundred and eighty minutes!
'¡De verdad hemos sacado adelante una celebración de seis horas en ciento ochenta minutos!'
Listen — do you hear the municipal clock tower chiming three up Linden Street?
'Escuchen: ¿oyen la torre del reloj municipal dando las tres calle Linden arriba?'
One chime, two chimes, three chimes... and wait, a car door just closed outside!
'Una campanada, dos campanadas, tres campanadas... y, un momento, ¡una puerta de coche acaba de cerrarse fuera!'
Someone just rang the brass gate bell twice — that is the signal from the brothers!
'Alguien acaba de tocar dos veces la campana de latón del portón: ¡esa es la señal de los hermanos!'
Look through the archway: Owen is carrying a battered brown leather suitcase!
'Miren por el arco: ¡Owen lleva una maleta de cuero marrón muy gastada!'
And walking beside Caleb with a silver walking stick and a wide straw hat...
'Y caminando junto a Caleb, con un bastón plateado y un sombrero de paja de ala ancha...'
Remember to lift the iron gate handle slightly first, Arthur, and smile!
'Acuérdate de levantar primero un poco la manija de hierro del portón, Arthur, ¡y sonríe!'
Welcome back to Linden Courtyard, my friend — thirty summers to the very week!
'¡Bienvenido de nuevo al Patio de los Tilos, amigo mío: treinta veranos justos, a la semana exacta!'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la escena, sin interrupciones.
Quick check before three strikes: jacket buttoned, shoes polished — where are my glasses?!
Miracle of miracles, Arthur, they are sitting squarely on your nose!
Do not touch them! Table one has hot mint tea, black tea, and warm plates ready.
Evelyn is at the walnut piano, and both Room Two and Six guests are smiling!
We actually pulled off a six-hour celebration in a hundred and eighty minutes!
Listen — do you hear the municipal clock tower chiming three up Linden Street?
One chime, two chimes, three chimes... and wait, a car door just closed outside!
Someone just rang the brass gate bell twice — that is the signal from the brothers!
Look through the archway: Owen is carrying a battered brown leather suitcase!
And walking beside Caleb with a silver walking stick and a wide straw hat...
Remember to lift the iron gate handle slightly first, Arthur, and smile!
Welcome back to Linden Courtyard, my friend — thirty summers to the very week!

Suenan tres campanadas, el pestillo del portón se levanta con suavidad y, después de treinta veranos, el cartógrafo de la habitación ocho vuelve a pisar el patio bajo el árbol. ¡Fin del quinto episodio! Nos vemos en el gran final de la tercera temporada.
See you soon!
